overview_description.description: Shuryan is a mobile application designed to assist users in locating information about doctors across various specialties and locations. It facilitates the scheduling and management of appointments, allowing users to view their reservations at any time. Additionally, it provides a paperless system that securely archives health reports for patients, ensuring data protection.
